# Bottom app bar — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the bottom app bar when a compact screen needs its actions docked along the bottom edge with a floating action button trailing. It is fixed-height chrome with two slots — `actions` leading, `fab` trailing — and it docks host controls rather than building its own: the docked button arrives host-owned, plain or menu, and the bar only positions it. There is no navigation model inside; three or more destinations is a navigation bar, while actions plus a button alone is this component. The bar is a toolbar landmark named by `label`, so it announces as the screen's action dock, and `children` carries anything that belongs between the two clusters.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the bottom app bar when a compact screen needs its actions docked along the bottom edge with a floating action button trailing — the native twin under the same contract. `actions` clusters navigation and action buttons leading while `fab` docks the plain button or button menu trailing, and both arrive host-owned: the bar positions them and owns no button behaviour of its own. There is no navigation model inside; three or more destinations is a navigation bar. The bar carries the host's accessible label, so it announces as the screen's action dock, and each docked control is a real pressable, so the bar itself adds no stops.
